meta_description: Wolf Plumbing provides expert gas engineering and plumbing services across Nottingham. Gas Safe registered, fast response, free quotes. Call 07885 275470 today.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Nottingham's Trusted Gas Engineers
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdowns, gas leaks, or heating faults — Wolf Plumbing gets Nottingham homes safe and warm, fast.
services_heading: Complete Gas & Plumbing Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full central heating installations, Wolf Plumbing covers every gas and plumbing need in Nottingham and the surrounding areas.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Fast diagnosis and repair of all boiler makes and models, keeping your home warm and your energy bills in check. Annual servicing also available to maintain efficiency and extend boiler life.

services.title: Boiler Installation
services.desc: Supply and installation of A-rated combi, system, and conventional boilers from leading manufacturers. We'll recommend the right boiler for your property size and hot water demand.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Full central heating system design and installation for new builds and older properties upgrading from storage heaters. Includes radiator balancing and system commissioning.

services.title: Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: Landlord gas safety inspections and CP12 certificates issued by our Gas Safe registered engineers. Keep your tenants protected and stay fully compliant with UK landlord legislation.

services.title: Emergency Gas & Heating Callouts
services.desc: Suspected gas leaks or a complete heating failure need urgent attention — our engineers respond quickly across Nottingham to make your property safe. Don't wait; call us straight away.

services.title: Plumbing Repairs & Installations
services.desc: Leaking pipes, dripping taps, blocked drains, and bathroom installations handled cleanly and efficiently. No job is too small, and all work is guaranteed for your peace of mind.

about_pullquote: Every job we do has our name on it — and that matters to us.
about_para_1: Wolf Plumbing was founded by a Gas Safe registered engineer with a straightforward goal: to give Nottingham homeowners and landlords a reliable, honest gas and plumbing service they can actually trust. Built on years of hands-on experience across the city and its surrounding areas, the business has grown steadily through word-of-mouth recommendation rather than flashy advertising.
about_para_2: What sets Wolf Plumbing apart is a no-nonsense approach — clear pricing, punctual engineers, and work done properly the first time. Customers come back year after year for boiler servicing and call us first in an emergency because they know we'll pick up the phone and turn up when we say we will.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Wolf Plumbing

reviews.text: Boiler packed in on a freezing Monday morning and Wolf Plumbing had an engineer out to us within the hour. Fixed the fault, explained exactly what had gone wrong, and the price was very fair. Brilliant service — wouldn't use anyone else.
reviews.author: Karen T.

reviews.text: Used Wolf Plumbing for my annual landlord gas safety certificate. Really professional, arrived on time, and had the CP12 certificate emailed over the same day. Exactly what you need as a landlord. Will definitely be booking again next year.
reviews.author: James R.

reviews.text: Had a new combi boiler installed by Wolf Plumbing last autumn. Competitive quote, tidy installation, and they took the old unit away without any fuss. The heating has been perfect ever since. Highly recommend to anyone in Nottingham.
reviews.author: Sophie M.
